$comment: The four forms behind the doors on the home page. Each is a sideways strip: one question per slide, every option shown at once on full-height tiles, and a sentence that fills in as the visitor answers. 'sentence' is that sentence: strings and {field} slots. Business questions and options are the deck's Start form (docs/02 §8), verbatim; the other three are drafted from the founder's brief 2026-09-21 and marked proposed. Nothing is sent until the forms are wired (milestone 8).
